name: Porcine Parasite
detailed_description:
Something isn't right in the pigpen.
A remote farm. A slaughterhouse gone silent. And a shape-shifting terror hiding in plain sight.

In this slow-burn, observation-based horror experience, you're the last line of defense between a hidden alien parasite and the rest of the planet. Your job? Study the pigs. Spot the impostor. Kill it. Miss it, and the consequences could be catastrophic.

Inspired by John Carpenter’s The Thing and atmospheric classics in the genre, this game blends creeping paranoia with biological horror. The enemy doesn’t attack head-on—it mimics, waits, and adapts. Only keen eyes and sharp instincts can reveal what doesn’t belong.

🧠 Key Features:

  • 🔍 Observation Horror: Watch for subtle behavioral anomalies—twitches, sounds, movements—no two playthroughs are exactly the same.

  • 🐷 Deadly Disguise: The alien mimics pigs perfectly—until it doesn’t. Hesitate and it might evolve… or escape.

  • 🌾 Isolated Atmosphere: Explore a gritty, realistic pig farm turned nightmare. Minimal HUD, maximum dread.

  • 💀 High Stakes: A single mistake could doom the world. But what if you kill the wrong pig?

Trust your eyes. Doubt everything else.
The fate of humanity might just squeal.

short_description: An alien hides among the pigs. Can you spot the imposter before it's too late? A tense observation horror game inspired by The Thing, where every oink could be your last.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains content that may not be appropriate for all audiences, including:

- Graphic depictions of violence and gore involving animals and alien entities
- Disturbing imagery, such as deformed or mutated pigs
- Themes of paranoia, body horror, and psychological tension
- Sudden loud noises and jump scares

Player discretion is advised.
